camera.perspective_note: Slight perspective: car length in px is largest near the left/right image edges and smallest near the centre (dark car 275 px at x~215 -> 264 px at x~950-1180; yellow car 276 px at x~1770 -> 268 px at x~1190-1300). This is a ~4% effect from the car's height under a perspective top-down camera. Treat the scene as one plane with one scale; for a size prior, the mid-video length (frames ~30-50) is the most representative.
